Expansive three-level residence with panoramic city outlooks, exceptional scale and solid concrete construction

Occupying an elevated position in one of Holland Park West's most tightly held streets, 12 Kneale Street is a substantial residence defined by extraordinary scale, impressive construction and sweeping views towards the Brisbane skyline.

Set across three levels on a 592sqm elevated allotment, this remarkable 618sqm residence offers an abundance of space for families seeking genuine flexibility, multiple living zones and room to grow. Solidly constructed with reinforced concrete floors and full concrete block walls, the home offers a level of strength, privacy and permanence rarely found in residences of this scale.

Inside, generous proportions are complemented by warm timber parquetry flooring, abundant natural light and expansive glazing. The main living level centres around a substantial kitchen, dining and family living area, with extensive timber cabinetry, ample preparation space and quality appliances.

From the main living space, glass doors open onto an extraordinary covered entertaining terrace of approximately 9.6m x 5.6m, a vast setting for large gatherings, outdoor dining and relaxed family entertaining that captures the elevated outlook.

The upper level is a private retreat. The master bedroom features a walk-in robe, ensuite and direct access to the approximately 10 metre wide balcony, complete with a private spa and views to the Brisbane skyline. The additional bedrooms are generously sized with built-in robes, served by a further ensuite and central bathroom, and a skylight brings extra light into one of the bedrooms.

The lower level reveals yet another dimension of living, with a dedicated media room, a separate gymnasium and multiple purpose rooms for a home office, teenagers' retreat, hobbies, storage or guest accommodation.

Whites Hill Reserve is nearby, with approximately 170 hectares of bushland, walking tracks, sporting fields and elevated viewpoints. Holland Park State High School and Marshall Road State School are close by, Carindale and Coorparoo are within easy reach, and the CBD is readily accessible.

This is a home designed for families who want more: more space, more separation, more entertaining options and more flexibility for every stage of family life. Inspection is essential to fully appreciate the scale, construction, versatility and outlook of this impressive residence.
